hoe.name: Hoe
hoe.description: Right-click the top of soil (grass, dirt, podzol): that 2x2 brick becomes tilled soil, smooth and furrowed. Seeds go on tilled soil.

scythe.name: Scythe
scythe.description: Right-click: harvests every ripe crop 3x3 round the plot (replanting from your seeds). Hold right-click and let go elsewhere: the whole rectangle.

watering_can.name: Watering can
watering_can.description: Left-click water to fill it (16 plots). Right-click tilled soil: wet for a day. Hold right-click and let go elsewhere: a whole rectangle.

wheat_seeds.name: Wheat seeds
wheat_seeds.description: Right-click tilled soil to plant. Found breaking grass by hand.

pumpkin_seeds.name: Pumpkin seeds
pumpkin_seeds.description: Right-click tilled soil to plant. Slow and thirsty: plant near water.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.description: Food. Right-click tilled soil to plant one.

potato.name: Potato
potato.description: Food. Right-click tilled soil to plant one.

beans.name: Beans
beans.description: Food. Right-click tilled soil to plant; beans give fertility back to the soil.

berries.name: Berries
berries.description: Food. Right-click tilled soil to plant a berry bush, which regrows after picking.

corn.name: Corn
corn.description: A cob of corn. Food; right-click tilled soil to plant one.

cabbage_seeds.name: Cabbage seeds
cabbage_seeds.description: Right-click tilled soil to plant. The quickest crop; fine in shade.

melon_seeds.name: Melon seeds
melon_seeds.description: Right-click tilled soil to plant. Very thirsty: plant beside water.

oak_sapling.name: Oak sapling
oak_sapling.description: Right-click the top of grass or dirt (no hoe needed): it grows into an oak. Felling a tree sometimes gives one.

dark_oak_sapling.name: Dark oak sapling
dark_oak_sapling.description: Right-click the top of grass or dirt: it grows into a dark oak.

birch_sapling.name: Birch sapling
birch_sapling.description: Right-click the top of grass or dirt: it grows into a birch.

acacia_sapling.name: Acacia sapling
acacia_sapling.description: Right-click the top of grass or dirt: it grows into an acacia.

compost.name: Compost
compost.description: Right-click tilled soil: +30 fertility. Made at a compost bin from leaves or crops.

grow_mix.name: Grow mix
grow_mix.description: Right-click a plot: the crop grows 50% faster for 2 days, +10 fertility. Made at a workbench from compost and coal.

compost_bin.name: Compost bin
compost_bin.description: Place it: compost recipes (leaves or crops into compost) can be made within 4 m of it.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.description: Place it by a field: birds keep off ripe crops within 8 m (most of them).

mulch.name: Mulch
mulch.description: Right-click a plot (or drag over a field): no weeds come up there, and the ones there are smothered. Made from leaves.

cactus_fruit.name: Cactus fruit
cactus_fruit.description: Food. Right-click tilled soil in a desert, badlands or savanna to plant one.

frostberries.name: Frostberries
frostberries.description: Food. Right-click tilled soil where it snows to plant a frostberry bush.

pineapple.name: Pineapple
pineapple.description: Food. Right-click tilled soil in a jungle to plant one.

sprinkler.name: Sprinkler
sprinkler.description: Place it in a field: every plot within 3 plots of it (7 x 7) stays wet. No water source needed.

collector.name: Collector
collector.description: Place it in a field: it harvests the ripe crops within 4 plots (9 x 9) into its own 27 slots and replants them from the seeds it holds. Right-click to open it.
